hosts.lh3.googleusercontent.com: Google Drive product photos, hotlinked and rate-limited (finding 2) - Phase 10 moves them
hosts.drive.google.com: brochure and lab-report scans and documents on the client's Drive (finding 2) - Phase 10 moves them
hosts.static.wixstatic.com: images still on the client's Wix CDN, which dies at cutover (finding 1) - Phase 10 moves them
hosts.video.wixstatic.com: the background video on the client's Wix CDN (finding 1) - Phase 10 moves it
hosts.flagcdn.com: language-switcher flag icons in the shared chrome, and five office-location flags on 聯絡我們. A FOURTH-PARTY CDN - moving to R2 with everything else at Phase 10 (owner, 18 Sep 2026): an exemption from the media contract is the beginning of a list of them
hosts.www.wonder-herb.com: two research PDFs under /_files/ugd/ - that is a WIX path on the client's own domain, not this repo (the files are not in it). They die at cutover exactly like the video (finding 1) - Phase 10 moves them

www.wonder-herb.com.why: A DUAL-ROLE HOST. This is our own domain - every canonical, hreflang and JSON-LD @id points at it - but /_files/ugd/ is Wix's user-file store, which we do not control and which dies when the Wix account is cancelled (finding 1). Only that path is media. Removing this entry is wrong in both directions: see the comment in scripts/test-media.js

schema.org.why: the JSON-LD @context and enum values (schema.org/InStock). Never fetched by a browser; an identifier, not a dependency

www.wonder-herb.com.why: our own canonicals, hreflang and the @id of the Organization node. ALSO a media host: /_files/ugd/ is Wix's file store and dies at cutover (finding 1), which is why it appears in media.hosts too

formurak4m.github.io.why: the GitHub Pages origin, named as a CORS origin so media still loads if the site is served from there before cutover

fonts.googleapis.com.why: webfont stylesheet, preconnected from every page. A third-party runtime dependency: if it is blocked or slow the page falls back to the CJK system stack (finding 21b)

cdnjs.cloudflare.com.why: three.js r128, GLTFLoader and OrbitControls for the homepage hero. Declared as `deps` in renderer/template.js BEHAVIOURS, not in markup. A third-party runtime dependency for the 3D slides only - the poster shows without it

mp.weixin.qq.com.why: the client's WeChat articles, linked from 微信發表文章. Outbound links to the client's own published content, not assets

wa.me.why: WhatsApp click-to-chat for the business number, in the chrome's floating button and the contact cards

maps.app.goo.gl.why: a Google Maps link on a contact card

www.google.com.why: the Google Maps iframe on 聯絡我們. An embedded third party: it sets its own cookies and is outside our media contract entirely

pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov.why: citations on 產品_憶活素 and 研究報告

www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov.why: a citation on 研究報告

chat._why: The floating chat widget (P13-T5). FRONT END ONLY: there is no answer backend yet, so the panel opens in its 'unavailable' state and routes the visitor to WhatsApp. Phase 15 replaces the single boundary in assets/behaviour/chat.js; none of these strings change when it does. Wording is owner-approved (24 Oct 2026). zh and en are approved text; de/es/fr/ja/ru are translations of that text and need a native read before cutover, falling back to zh if any is removed.
